verdict.detail: Discogs lists 12 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

physical: Pressed by CBS Pressing Plant, Aston Clinton

notes.text:
Issued in a matte-finish picture card sleeve, plain paper inner Made in Great Britain, Patent Nos. 1,125,555.
All songs published by Virgin Music (Publishers) Ltd., except A5 Virgin Music (Publishers) Ltd./Island Music Ltd. and B4b Rondor Music (London) Ltd..
Tracks B4a and B4b are listed as one on the sleeve and on the labels with time given 3:24.
This copy states that the country of manufacture is as stated on the Record Label, this is not so although it is probably a UK copy.
Variant 8 has a sticker "Special Price" at the top right of the sleeve and "The Police" in red. Inner sleeve has "Special Price High Quality Pressing" stamped.
(P) 1978 A&M Records Ltd.
Publishers: 
A1-A4, B1-B3,B4a,B5: Virgin Music Publishers Limited.
A5: Virgin Music Publishers Limited/ Island Music Limited
B4b: Rondor Music (London) Ltd.

Matrices are etched except for the 'CBS' letter & number stamps away from the main matrix string: "A, B, C, D, E, 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 11"
